summary: Inspect a ligand and nearby residues from a supplied authoritative deposited structure while preserving atom, assembly and model metadata.
objective: Select a deposited ligand, vary an explicit heavy-atom cutoff and inspect which source residues enter the site.
intent_signals: Inspect residues around a ligand in a PDB structure.
Show a protein binding pocket from supplied coordinates.
example_prompts: Build an inspector for ligand MK1 in supplied PDB entry 1HSG, showing heavy-atom distances and deposited metadata.
not_for: Predicting binding affinity, efficacy, druggability or biological function.
Inventing missing atoms, bonds, hydrogens or alternate conformations without an explicit derived-data step.

entities.name: Deposited structure identity
entities.guidance: Show entry ID, entry version, model, assembly, chain/asym IDs, ligand component ID, experimental method and resolution from the supplied record.

entities.name: Ligand and site residues
entities.guidance: Preserve source atom IDs and coordinates in angstroms; select residues by minimum non-hydrogen atom distance to the chosen ligand.

entities.name: Pocket context
entities.guidance: Show enough surrounding protein to distinguish an exposed groove from an enclosed pocket; any surface algorithm, probe radius and grid spacing are derived settings.

entities.name: Measurement probe
entities.guidance: Draw selected atom-to-atom distances in angstroms. Label inferred interaction categories separately from deposited atoms and measured distances.

state_contract.model: A supplied mmCIF/PDB entry and selected biological assembly own atom identity and Cartesian coordinates in angstroms. For cutoff c, default 4.0 angstrom, select each polymer residue having at least one non-hydrogen atom within c of a selected ligand non-hydrogen atom.
state_contract.authority: Deposited entry/version, model, assembly, atom_site identifiers, coordinates, occupancy and B values own the view. Cutoff, atom radii, surface algorithm and visual encoding are declared derivations.
actions: Select a deposited ligand instance and assembly.
Change cutoff from 3.5 to 6.0 angstrom and recompute the residue set.
Inspect source IDs, occupancy, B value and one measured distance.
Toggle site sticks, context and derived pocket surface; reset without losing provenance.

invariants: An accelerated neighbour search exactly matches a brute-force non-hydrogen all-pairs residue set for the same cutoff.
Every displayed atom and residue resolves to its deposited identifier; coordinates, occupancy and B values round-trip to parsed source values.
Cutoff and distances display angstrom units and are invariant under camera or display scaling.
Any alternate-location filtering and biological-assembly transform are disclosed rather than silently flattened.
motion_guidance: Cutoff changes are discrete recomputations; interpolation between old and new surfaces is presentation only.
Camera fly-throughs do not imply ligand trajectories or docking.
creative_affordances: Use ribbon context, clipped molecular surface, labelled sticks or a focused pocket diorama while retaining source identity and measurement legibility.
known_limits: A distance-defined residue set is an inspection convention, not proof of binding energy, interaction type or biological relevance.
Deposited coordinates are an experimental model with method, resolution, occupancy and conformer limits.
Authored and source-reviewed draft only; no structure parser, surface extraction or renderer was run.

claims.statement: Khazanov and Carlson defined a ligand binding site as protein residues having at least one non-hydrogen atom within 4.0 angstrom of a ligand non-hydrogen atom.
claims.scope: The cited study's reproducible selection convention; not a universal physical boundary or interaction definition.

source_refs.locator: Methods, Large, Non-redundant Data Set of Binding Sites, paragraphs 1-4

claims.statement: RCSB entry 1HSG version 1.3 identifies a 2.00-angstrom X-ray HIV-1 protease complex whose biological assembly is a homodimer and whose deposited ligand component is MK1.
claims.scope: RCSB PDB entry 1HSG metadata as accessed; use the cited entry version rather than generalizing to other structures.

source_refs.locator: Entry identity and version; Experimental Data Snapshot; Biological Assembly 1; Small Molecules MK1

object_craft.structure: Keep polymer chains, ligand instances, waters, alternates, site residues, measurements and derived surfaces as stable selectable groups.
object_craft.material: Atom and chain colours carry declared categories; translucency and surface polish must not imply occupancy, confidence or affinity.

physical_contract.scope: Static deposited-coordinate inspection; no docking, molecular dynamics or contact forces.
checks: Brute-force and accelerated cutoff selections match exactly.
Source atom metadata and measured angstrom distances round-trip.
